content:
**Fraternity Row** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

Fraternity Row is a location in Morgantown where several collegiate sponsored residences are located.

Residences include:

- Three notes can be found inside the same trash can behind the Delta Tau Epsilon fraternity house, located at the top of the hill next to the Eta Psi Epsilon Tau fraternity:
- Feeling Good, Looking Good - Holotape, found on a table with a parasol in the front yard of a house located at the top of the hill. From Eta Psi House, follow the road leading northeast, it is the fourth house to the right.
- Note from a Concerned Neighbor - Tucked under the welcome mat of a house lit with Christmas lights next to the parking garage.

Fraternity Row appears in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wild Appalachia* update.

The fraternity houses were designed by Steve Massey. [Dev 1]
